# Lakshya Gupta - Portfolio & Blog

## Pages
- /: Portfolio homepage with about, skills, projects, AI toolkit, writings, and contact.
- /blog: Chess-Tech Chronicles with posts on chess, AI, code, and learning systems.
- /ai: AI, Chess & Technology page for study workflows, Python tools, and automation ideas.
- /pulse/: Dynamic article reader.
- /resources: Chess-tech resources, prompts, templates, and study systems.
- /contact: Contact form and social links.
